decisions.reason: As the current generation of the core analog voltage input module it remains a basic building block with steady demand and no successor in sight.
The standalone MQTT proxy is increasingly redundant next to integrated MQTT bindings, but it costs little to keep available for existing users.
CO2 sensing demand stayed high through the pandemic, though a newer sensor generation and chip shortages could prompt replacement.
A cheap accessory that complements display modules and needs little maintenance, so there is little reason to remove it.
